evidence: The body queries contextual status IDs 0x24 and 0x26, returns true when either query succeeds, and otherwise calls a helper with selector 3 then compares its result against the second input (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0054.c:22062-22087). Callers consume the returned boolean after passing attribute-related values (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0087.c:14666-14672; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0088.c:1625-1628).

When x2 is nonzero, the function forwards unchanged to find_attribute_record_matching_decoded_key; when x2 is zero, it returns zero (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0056.c:13114-13121). Callers pass a pointer in x2 and use the boolean result, but provide no more specific operation semantics (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0057.c:11538-11542).

The function reads a context pointer from input object +0x20, requires its qwords at +0x218 and +0x220 to match, queries status ID 0x13, requires the low byte of the returned value to equal 4, then stores the second input byte at object +0x2c and tail-calls a helper with the object's qword at +0x20 and selector 8 (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0035.c:40700-40719). Its caller is dispatch_context_status_attribute_event and passes the candidate attribute record (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0053.c:2931-2933).

The routine obtains a callback/dispatcher from the object at input1 +0x130 and invokes it with input0, the low 32 bits of input2, and an output pointer; on success it forwards the returned value to populate_contextual_player_attribute_status_values (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0007.c:16457-16471). Its caller supplies a player-attribute slot address and a status/index value, including through a tail-call loop (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0007.c:54645-54649).

After a helper obtains a base value, the routine dispatches attribute-delta application for the input index, then for indices 0 or 1 computes one of two offsets (0x5db0 or 0x5e20) from a returned base and passes the chosen address to a further helper (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0033.c:44924-44940). The gameplay player-attribute update caller invokes it with index 3 and the current record (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0033.c:44700-44703).
